description: This file declares interfaces related to Lua conditions in the lighttpd server, including initialization, retrieval, and setting of Lua conditions, with references to Lua and lighttpd core headers.

methods.name: li_lua_init_condition_mt
methods.description: Initializes the Lua metatable for conditions in the server context.

methods.name: li_lua_get_condition
methods.description: Retrieves a condition object from the Lua state at a given index.

methods.name: li_lua_push_condition
methods.description: Pushes a condition object onto the Lua stack.

methods.name: li_lua_set_global_condition_lvalues
methods.description: Sets global condition values within the Lua environment for the server.
